description: Returns a section of an Indian Act from a curated dataset — the section text as held in the firm’s annotated bare-acts library (reproduced from the enacted Act), a plain-English explanation, a practitioner note, the penalty, the corresponding old- or new-code section and the amendment history, where recorded. Covers 20 Acts (Constitution, BNS 2023, BNSS 2023, IPC 1860, CrPC 1973, SARFAESI Act 2002, NI Act 1881, Contract Act 1872, Companies Act 2013, IBC 2016, CPC 1908, CPA 2019, RERA 2016, TPA 1882, Arbitration Act 1996, BSA 2023, IT Act 2000, RTI Act 2005, Limitation Act 1963, Specific Relief Act 1963); for the BNS and BNSS, every section's enacted heading is also available. Use when a user cites or asks about a specific section or article.

act.description: The Act: constitution = Constitution; bns = BNS 2023; bnss = BNSS 2023; ipc = IPC 1860; crpc = CrPC 1973; sarfaesi = SARFAESI Act 2002; ni-act = NI Act 1881; contract-act = Contract Act 1872; companies-act = Companies Act 2013; ibc = IBC 2016; cpc = CPC 1908; consumer-protection = CPA 2019; rera = RERA 2016; tpa = TPA 1882; arbitration-act = Arbitration Act 1996; bsa = BSA 2023; it-act = IT Act 2000; rti-act = RTI Act 2005; limitation-act = Limitation Act 1963; specific-relief = Specific Relief Act 1963
